[IALC.8.2] Under `realtime`/`constspace` the pump is allocation-free,
so an override affects only INIT and non-RT allocation. The
`DS_ALLOC_WEAK` wrapper is a single tail-callable cold-path frame and is
never on the hot path. `-flto` does not erase it for a prebuilt archive
(LTO bitcode is toolchain-version-locked, and inlining an interposable
weak symbol would defeat override); it is a permanent, negligible
cold-path cost.
